title: Compute & close
covers: a company's section: depreciation, losses, MAT and its credit (ITR-6)
ITR-3 / ITR-5 JSON and the 3CD JSON
the rules and assumptions behind the JSON
original, belated, revised and updated returns

steps.say: Turn the mapped books and 26AS into the return in {product}: the computation, interest, the filing files in the department's own format, sign-off, filing and revisions.
The strip: mapped, reconciled, computed, signed off, filed, closed.
Each head adds its mapped rows; house property gets its 30%. Pick the regime here.

For a company, its own section: the option's rate and surcharge, depreciation block by block, losses set off and carried (8 years, s.79, unabsorbed depreciation), MAT against the normal tax and the MAT credit, 80M and 80G - and below, the year's facts to type: the earlier year's turnover, losses and credit brought forward, dividends paid.
234A, 234B and 234C come from the 26AS challans by date; a senior citizen with no business income pays no advance-tax interest. Type a figure only to override.
On a refund, 244A interest at half a percent a month - none when the refund is under 10% of the tax.

The ITR JSON and, for an audit, the Form 3CB-3CD JSON - each checked against the CBDT schema before you download, with what is still missing listed. The balance sheet tallies and the P&L profit matches business income.

Right under the JSON, every rule and assumption that made it, numbered and in plain words, with this client's own figures: the return type and its due date, how the name and address were read, the regime, the tax, surcharge, cess and interest, advance tax against self-assessment tax, and the bank that receives the refund. Each line names the chip that decided it, and anything you must fix before you upload shows in amber.
A reviewer signs off; then the acknowledgement number and date filed. The return type - original, belated, revised or ITR-U - follows from the dates.
Start a revised return, or an ITR-U after 31 December with its 140B additional tax; discard a revision; or undo a wrong 'filed' with a reason. Nothing filed is ever deleted.
Every change to this client and year, field by field - the regime, the interest typed in, sign-off, filing - with when and who.
